messages:
Maya Cheng: pushed a change to the continuous batching coalescer heuristic ~09:12 UTC to prefer earlier-formed microbatches for small requests. Immediately saw a tail latency jump on the small-reqs lane. p50 unchanged, p95 ~120ms -> ~520ms. throughput down ~8%.

deploy-bot: maya deployed branch feat/heuristic-coalesce-v2 at 2026-03-18T09:12:34Z (deploy id dpl_7781).

Oliver Park: ack. can you drop the perf snapshot and the batcher metrics timeframe? need batch sizes, queue wait distribution, and kernel selection counts around the spike.

Maya Cheng: pasting quick metrics (trimmed):
```
small-reqs: p95_latency_ms: 520 -> 120
throughput_rps: 185 -> 170
avg_batch_size: 1.6 -> 1.2
queue_wait_p95_ms: 18 -> 95
kernel_choice: fast-kernel: 72% -> 31%, slow-kernel: 28% -> 69%
```

Nora Kim: hmm kernel flip looks suspicious. When batches shrink we fall back to slow-kernel due to shape/sequence heuristics. Did the new coalescer change max-delay or token_budget gating?

Maya Cheng: only change was: prefer_coalesce_age_ms from 8 -> 2 and bias_towards_older=true. didn't touch token_budget. thought earlier microbatches would give better packing.

Samir Patel: that would reduce the window for waiting, so we get smaller batches with more heterogeneity -> kernel selector probably sees more variety and picks a conservative kernel. Also KV cache hit pattern might change: if requests are shorter we lose prefix reuse. Can we check kv_cache_hit_rate and kv_prefix_len?

Maya Cheng: grabbing that now. quick numbers for same window:
```
kv_cache_hit_rate: 0.61 -> 0.27
avg_kv_prefix_len: 42 -> 9
```

Oliver Park: ok that explains it. coalescer made earlier dispatches with tiny batches, losing KV reuse, causing more recompute in slow kernel and higher queue_wait (retry/pathing). Two simultaneous effects: decreased batching + worse KV locality -> kernel fallback and tail.

Samir Patel: suggested mitigation options: 1) revert prefer_coalesce_age_ms to 8 (fast revert) 2) instead keep age=2 but increase token_budget threshold to prefer larger batches for requests with presence of KV hits 3) force kernel_affinity override for small-reqs lane for next 30m while we instrument. I'd vote revert+instrument first.

Maya Cheng: can revert now. revert PR ready: revert/feat-coalesce-v2. Do we want a canary or full rollback?

Oliver Park: do a canary to one region first (us-west) then watch p95, kernel_choice, kv_hit. if it stabilizes, roll global. deploy-bot, canary to us-west tag=canary-usw?

deploy-bot: starting canary deploy of revert/feat-coalesce-v2 to us-west (canary tag canary-usw). started 2026-03-18T09:24:11Z.

Nora Kim: I'll run a short flamegraph on the infra pod handling small-reqs once canary is live; looking for CPU stalls and kernel load shifts.

Maya Cheng: thanks. i'll keep running perf traces and post results. if canary doesn't help in 10m I'll trigger full rollback. :thumbsup:

Oliver Park: also add a quick gating test for future coalescer changes: simulate kv_prefix reuse distribution and assert kernel_choice remains >60% fast-kernel for small-reqs. avoid surprising kernel flips.

Samir Patel: filing a small RFC for that test + a dashboard alert (kernel_choice_drop) if fast-kernel % drops >30% in 5m. assigning to eng-runtime infra.

Maya Cheng: update: canary shows p95 down to ~130ms within 3m of revert, kv_hit_rate climbing back to ~0.58. looks like revert fixed it. will roll global in 6m.

Oliver Park: great. postmortem points: interaction between coalescer age and kv-cache locality -> kernel selector behavior. Add regression test and a warning note in the coalescer config doc.

Maya Cheng: creating short postmortem thread and PR with tests. closing here once global roll done.
